name: sentry_list_issues
description: List Sentry issues filtered by query, sort, environment, and project. Defaults to unresolved issues sorted by date.

name: sentry_get_issue
description: Get full details for a specific Sentry issue by its ID.

name: sentry_update_issue
description: Update a Sentry issue's status, assignee, or seen state.

name: sentry_resolve_issue
description: Mark a Sentry issue as resolved.

name: sentry_ignore_issue
description: Ignore a Sentry issue so it stops appearing in the default view.

name: sentry_delete_issue
description: Permanently delete a Sentry issue.

name: sentry_list_issue_events
description: List events (individual occurrences) for a Sentry issue.

name: sentry_get_latest_event
description: Get the most recent event for a Sentry issue, including full stack trace.

name: sentry_bulk_update_issues
description: Update multiple Sentry issues at once — e.g. resolve or ignore a batch of issues.

name: sentry_assign_issue
description: Assign a Sentry issue to a specific user or team.

name: sentry_list_issue_tags
description: List all tags attached to a Sentry issue (browser, environment, user, etc.).

name: sentry_get_issue_tag_values
description: Get all distinct values for a specific tag on a Sentry issue — e.g. all affected user emails.

tag_key.description: Tag key e.g. user, browser, environment

name: sentry_get_issue_hashes
description: Get the event hashes used for deduplication of a Sentry issue.

name: sentry_merge_issues
description: Merge multiple Sentry issues into a single parent issue.

name: sentry_list_project_events
description: List raw events for a Sentry project with optional query filtering.

name: sentry_get_event
description: Get a specific event by its ID in a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_projects
description: List all Sentry projects in the organization.

name: sentry_get_project
description: Get details for a specific Sentry project.

name: sentry_create_project
description: Create a new Sentry project under a team.

name: sentry_update_project
description: Update a Sentry project's name, platform, or settings.

name: sentry_delete_project
description: Delete a Sentry project.

name: sentry_get_project_stats
description: Get event volume statistics for a Sentry project over a time range.

name: sentry_list_project_keys
description: List DSN client keys for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_create_project_key
description: Create a new DSN client key for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_delete_project_key
description: Delete a DSN client key from a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_teams
description: List all teams in the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_get_team
description: Get details for a specific Sentry team.

name: sentry_create_team
description: Create a new team in the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_update_team
description: Update a Sentry team's name.

name: sentry_delete_team
description: Delete a Sentry team.

name: sentry_list_team_members
description: List members of a Sentry team.

name: sentry_list_members
description: List all members of the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_get_member
description: Get details for a specific organization member.

name: sentry_list_releases
description: List releases for the organization or a specific project.

name: sentry_get_release
description: Get details for a specific release version.

name: sentry_create_release
description: Create a new release in Sentry to associate errors with a specific version.

version.description: Release version e.g. '1.2.0' or a git SHA

name: sentry_finalize_release
description: Mark a release as finalized/deployed in Sentry.

name: sentry_delete_release
description: Delete a release from Sentry.

name: sentry_list_release_commits
description: List commits associated with a Sentry release.

name: sentry_list_release_deploys
description: List deployments for a Sentry release.

name: sentry_create_release_deploy
description: Record a deployment event for a Sentry release in a specific environment.

name: sentry_list_alert_rules
description: List metric alert rules for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_get_alert_rule
description: Get details for a specific Sentry metric alert rule.

name: sentry_delete_alert_rule
description: Delete a metric alert rule from a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_issue_alert_rules
description: List issue-based alert rules (notifications) for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_monitors
description: List all cron job monitors in the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_get_monitor
description: Get details for a specific cron monitor.

name: sentry_create_monitor
description: Create a new cron job monitor to track scheduled job health.

name: sentry_update_monitor
description: Update a cron monitor's schedule or mute state.

name: sentry_delete_monitor
description: Delete a cron monitor.

name: sentry_list_monitor_checkins
description: List recent check-ins for a cron monitor to see health history.

name: sentry_get_org_stats
description: Get organization-wide error/transaction volume stats grouped by outcome.

name: sentry_list_dashboards
description: List all dashboards in the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_get_dashboard
description: Get a specific Sentry dashboard and its widgets.

name: sentry_list_debug_files
description: List debug info files (dSYMs, PDB files, source maps) for a project.

name: sentry_list_source_map_archives
description: List source map artifact bundles uploaded to a Sentry project.

name: sentry_triage_errors
description: SUPER TOOL: Get top unresolved errors sorted by user impact — issue ID, title, error count, users affected, and last seen — ready for triage.

name: sentry_production_health
description: SUPER TOOL: Production health check — project count, top 5 recent unresolved issues, and error volume stats in one call.

name: sentry_deploy_release
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a release in Sentry and immediately mark it as deployed to an environment — the standard CI/CD workflow in one call.

name: sentry_create_issue_alert_rule
description: Create an issue-based notification alert rule for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_update_issue_alert_rule
description: Update an existing issue notification alert rule in Sentry.

name: sentry_delete_issue_alert_rule
description: Delete an issue notification alert rule from a Sentry project.

name: sentry_create_metric_alert_rule
description: Create a metric-based alert rule (e.g. alert when error rate > N in 60 min).

name: sentry_run_discover_query
description: Run a Sentry Discover analytics query — event counts, error rates, latencies by any field.

name: sentry_list_environments
description: List all environments configured in the Sentry organization or project.

name: sentry_list_project_tags
description: List all tag keys tracked in a Sentry project.

name: sentry_get_tag_values
description: Get all distinct values for a specific tag key in a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_user_feedback
description: List user-submitted feedback reports for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_uptime_subscriptions
description: List uptime monitoring subscriptions for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_create_uptime_subscription
description: Create an uptime monitor to check a URL's availability at regular intervals.

name: sentry_delete_uptime_subscription
description: Delete an uptime monitoring subscription from a Sentry project.

name: sentry_get_performance_summary
description: Query performance metrics for transactions using Sentry Discover — returns p50/p75/p95 latency, error rate, and throughput. Filter by transaction name, environment, or date range. Requires Sentry performance monitoring to be enabled.

transaction.description: Filter to a specific transaction name

name: sentry_list_transactions
description: List the slowest transactions in a Sentry project ranked by p95 latency. Helps identify which endpoints or background jobs are causing the most latency for users.

name: sentry_get_span_samples
description: Get sample spans for a specific transaction to identify which database queries, HTTP calls, or other sub-operations are causing slowness. Returns span durations broken down by type.

name: sentry_list_saved_searches
description: List saved issue searches for a project or organization. Saved searches are reusable filters like 'assigned to me' or 'critical errors in production' that appear in the Sentry sidebar.

name: sentry_create_saved_search
description: Create a saved search filter for a Sentry project or organization. Saved searches appear in the sidebar and can be shared across the team. Examples: 'is:unresolved assigned:me', 'is:unresolved level:fatal'.

query.description: Sentry issue search query, e.g. 'is:unresolved level:fatal'

name: sentry_delete_saved_search
description: Delete a saved search by its ID. Use sentry_list_saved_searches first to find the search ID.

name: sentry_list_replays
description: List session replays in a Sentry project. Returns replay metadata including duration, error count, page URLs visited, and user info. Replays let you watch exactly what a user did before an error occurred.

name: sentry_get_replay
description: Get detailed metadata for a specific session replay by ID. Returns full replay info including all page URLs, error IDs encountered, device info, and SDK details. Use sentry_list_replays to find replay IDs.

name: sentry_list_spike_protections
description: List spike protection settings for a Sentry project. Spike protection automatically drops events when your error volume spikes unexpectedly, protecting your quota from a runaway error.

name: sentry_enable_spike_protection
description: Enable or disable spike protection for a Sentry project. When enabled, Sentry automatically drops events during abnormal traffic spikes to protect your monthly quota.

name: sentry_performance_health
description: SUPER TOOL: Get a full performance health snapshot — the 5 slowest transactions by p95 latency plus the most recent unresolved errors, all in one parallel call. Use for morning health checks and post-deploy performance verification.

name: sentry_get_data_scrubbing_config
description: Get the org-level data scrubbing and PII configuration for Sentry.

name: sentry_update_data_scrubbing_config
description: Update PII/data scrubbing settings — sensitive fields, safe fields, IP scrubbing.

name: sentry_list_inbound_filters
description: List inbound event filters for a Sentry project (localhost, browser extensions, web crawlers, etc.).

name: sentry_create_org_inbound_filter
description: Enable or disable an inbound filter for a Sentry project (e.g. filter localhost errors).

name: sentry_get_codeowners
description: Get the CODEOWNERS configuration for a Sentry project (auto-assignment rules).

name: sentry_create_codeowners
description: Create a CODEOWNERS file for a Sentry project to auto-assign issues by code path.

name: sentry_update_codeowners
description: Update a CODEOWNERS file for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_create_dashboard
description: Create a new Sentry dashboard with widgets.

name: sentry_update_dashboard
description: Update a Sentry dashboard's title or widgets.

name: sentry_delete_dashboard
description: Delete a Sentry dashboard.

name: sentry_list_notification_actions
description: List notification actions (Slack, PagerDuty, etc.) configured in the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_create_notification_action
description: Create a notification action to route Sentry alerts to Slack, PagerDuty, or other services.

name: sentry_delete_notification_action
description: Delete a Sentry notification action.

name: sentry_get_org
description: Get the Sentry organization details and settings.

name: sentry_update_org
description: Update Sentry organization settings (name, features, security settings).

name: sentry_get_org_integrations
description: List all third-party integrations configured for the Sentry organization.

name: sentry_get_ownership_rules
description: Get issue ownership rules for a Sentry project (routes issues to teams/users by path).

name: sentry_update_ownership_rules
description: Update issue ownership rules for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_list_grouping_configs
description: List available issue grouping configurations in Sentry.

name: sentry_update_project_grouping
description: Update the issue grouping configuration for a Sentry project.

name: sentry_org_security_posture
description: SUPER TOOL: Organization security posture — 2FA coverage, PII settings, project count, and integrations in one call.

name: sentry_alert_coverage_audit
description: SUPER TOOL: Alert coverage audit — which projects have no issue or metric alerts configured.

name: sentry_get_project_data_scrubbing
description: Compatibility name for the complete Sentry project response, including its configuration. Use sentry_get_project.
